'''Tyko Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the younger brother of [[Bornan Thul]], and he used his share of the family fortune to buy and run the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factory on [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]]. There he found the shell of the abandoned [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]], and had it refitted as a personal bodyguard. He staged his own capture by IG-88 in an attempt to lure his brother out into the open.

After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], he helped out his sister-in-law [[Aryn Dro Thul|Aryn]] in the day-to-day running of [[Bornaryn Trading]].

== Personality and Traits ==
Tyko Thul had blonde hair and hazel eyes, he was overweight and wore bright robes. Tyko had a high opinion of himself and his business on Mechis III, was dismissive of his brother's disappearance, believing his brother to have intentionally vanished, and showed little concern for the possibility of Bornan being hurt or dead. He had a strong temper and looked down on other beings and droids. He had some prejudices against non-Humans as when he reprogrammed IG-88 and the other assassin droids, he removed their ability to kill Humans so they would technically not be assassin droids, but left in their ability to harm any species that was not Human, Bornan showed some more positive traits, praising M-TD's capabilities and showing some gratitude towards his nephew's friends for helping his family.  {{Char-stub}}
